title: Constrained resource-allocation optimization
primary_chapter_title: Human–AI Decision Systems and Managerial Action
purpose: Selects an allocation across candidate AI or service options to maximize expected value subject to budget, workforce, capacity, and minimum-service constraints.
input: `Options` sheet with option, unit_cost, value_per_unit, maximum_units, workforce_hours_per_unit, capacity_units_per_unit, and minimum_units; `Parameters` sheet with budget, workforce hours, and capacity available.
outputs: Optimal units, resource use, expected value, binding constraints, comparison with simple ranking, and allocation chart.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
